Free recipes for signing in

Design for review, 16 Nov 2026. Every new screen and state, light and dark side by side. Self-contained: Vollkorn falls back to Georgia here; the design file uses the real font. The full set, with triggers, is the Free recipes page of design.html.

Decisions to confirm

  1. The offer is an outline button with a gift, straight under the form's primary (Share prompt, or Generate on this device); Buy recipes drops to a text button beside Share prompt. It never takes the filled slot.
  2. Always the real number: "Sign in and get 3 free recipes" (one: "Sign in and get a free recipe"). With no answer, 0, a failed call or an older server, every place is exactly as today: no hint, no placeholder, plain Sign in buttons.
  3. How the hint enters: put in place at once, no animation, only while the action group is out of view (the usual case on phones, where it sits at the end of the form); if the group is on screen when the answer arrives, it waits for the next time the tab is shown. Open sheets never change while open.
  4. Signed in and not claimed: "Get 3 free recipes" from welcomeRecipes beside the balance; one tap claims, with no sheet.
  5. In a menu set the too-few callout and Buy (filled) stay; the offer goes under Buy with one line saying whether the free recipes cover this menu.
  6. Sign-in step is a sheet: gift emblem, "Get 3 free recipes", one sentence, three rows (what they are, kept in an account, what the account is), the once-per-account line, the existing sign-in buttons, Not now.
  7. Outcomes: granted is a T3 snackbar with the count in the bar going to 3 and Generate recipe becoming primary; already is a dialog (the person signed in for nothing and is now signed in), with See recipe packs; off is a T3 snackbar; a cancelled sign-in shows nothing.
  8. How recipes work: one sentence in the packs row, and with an offer the second action becomes the offer instead of See recipe packs (packs stay one tap away from the bar and Buy).
  9. Buy sheet: one text button under the packs, "Or sign in and get 3 free recipes".
  10. Proposed beyond the spec: any sign-in made while an offer is showing claims (Recipe settings' buttons too, not only the offer); someone with recipes on this device sees one line that signing in also gets free recipes; the offer is hidden while buying is paused or blocked, as Buy is.

On the Recipe form

Where the offer sits in the action group, signed out (from the day's answer) and signed in (from beside the balance), each with an offer of 3, of 1 and none, with and without the device's own model, in a menu set, and in German and Russian.

Drawn as no offer, with no placeholder and no spinner. How the hint enters: the action group is at the end of a long form, below the fold on phones, so an answer that arrives while the group is out of view is put in place at once, with no animation, and the person scrolls to a finished group. If the group is on screen when the answer arrives (tablets, a short pantry, or already scrolled down), nothing moves: the hint waits for the next time the tab is shown, which the day's cache makes immediate. Open sheets (How recipes work, Buy) never change while open either.

How recipes work

Tick what you want to use up, choose the kind of dish, and get a recipe built around it. Recipes you get in the app are saved on this device as they arrive.

  • Free, with any AI app
    Share or copy a ready-made prompt to the AI app you already use.
  • Free, on this device
    This device writes the recipe itself, and nothing is sent anywhere.
  • From a recipe pack
    Our server writes the recipe, and can also plan a menu set. A recipe takes 1 recipe from a pack; a menu set takes 1 to 6, depending on its days and courses a day. Packs from £2.99. Sign in to get 3 free recipes and try it. The free ways stay there when you have a pack.

You can open this again in Recipe settings.

Get 3 free recipes

Sign in, and our server adds 3 free recipes to your account, so you can try what a pack gives.

  • Written by our server
    They work like recipes from a pack: a single recipe, or a menu if there are enough.
  • Kept in your account
    They, and any recipes you buy later, follow you to a new phone wherever you sign in.
  • An account on our server
    We keep your account ID and email address. Signing in sends nothing from your pantry, and you can delete the account in Recipe settings.

Free recipes are given once per Apple or Google account.

    They work like recipes from a pack: a single recipe, or a menu if there are enough.
  • Kept in your account
    They, and any recipes you buy later, follow you to a new phone wherever you sign in.
  • An account on our server
    We keep your account ID and email address. Signing in sends nothing from your pantry, and you can delete the account in Recipe settings.

Free recipes are given once per Apple or Google account.

Hol dir 3 kostenlose Rezepte

Melde dich an, und unser Server schreibt deinem Konto 3 kostenlose Rezepte gut, damit du ausprobieren kannst, was ein Paket bietet.

  • Von unserem Server geschrieben
    Sie funktionieren wie Rezepte aus einem Paket: ein einzelnes Rezept oder, wenn es reicht, ein Menü.
  • In deinem Konto
    Sie und alle Rezepte, die du später kaufst, kommen mit auf ein neues Handy, wo immer du dich anmeldest.
  • Ein Konto auf unserem Server
    Wir speichern deine Konto-ID und E-Mail-Adresse. Bei der Anmeldung wird nichts aus deinen Vorräten gesendet, und du kannst das Konto in den Rezepteinstellungen löschen.

Kostenlose Rezepte gibt es einmal pro Apple- oder Google-Konto.

Получите 3 бесплатных рецепта

Войдите, и наш сервер добавит в ваш аккаунт 3 бесплатных рецепта, чтобы вы попробовали, что даёт пакет.

  • Пишет наш сервер
    Они работают как рецепты из пакета: один рецепт или меню, если их хватает.
  • Хранятся в вашем аккаунте
    Они и рецепты, которые вы купите позже, будут на новом телефоне, где бы вы ни вошли.
  • Аккаунт на нашем сервере
    Мы храним идентификатор аккаунта и адрес почты. При входе ничего из кладовой не отправляется, а удалить аккаунт можно в настройках рецептов.

Бесплатные рецепты даются один раз на аккаунт Apple или Google.

Prompt ready to share

Get 3 free recipes

Sign in, and our server adds 3 free recipes to your account, so you can try what a pack gives.

  • Written by our server
    They work like recipes from a pack: a single recipe, or a menu if there are enough.
  • Kept in your account
    They, and any recipes you buy later, follow you to a new phone wherever you sign in.
  • An account on our server
    We keep your account ID and email address. Signing in sends nothing from your pantry, and you can delete the account in Recipe settings.

Free recipes are given once per Apple or Google account.

HomeRecipe5ShoppingSettings

A sheet, not a full screen: one decision. A gift emblem, the title with the number, one sentence on what it gives, three rows in the How recipes work style (what they are, kept in an account, what the account is), the once-per-account line, then the existing sign-in buttons, then Not now. No price. Only reached from an offer with a number, so the sheet always has one. Cancelling the system sign-in leaves this sheet as it was, with no message.
